# Patient flow

The door-to-door funnel — every patient walks **arrived → in-exam → optics → billing → done**, and a one-tap stage note records why anyone is parked.

```ui-flow
```

```ui-actions
items:
  - Open refraction desk | open-note:Solo/Refraction.md
  - Open dispensing & orders | open-note:Solo/Dispensing.md
  - Open billing & day close | open-note:Solo/Money.md
  - Open appointment book | open-note:Clinic/Appointment.md
```

## Stage legend

Statuses: **booked** · **arrived** · **in-exam** · **optics** · **billing** · **done** · **no-show**

| Stage | What happens there | One-tap note convention |
| --- | --- | --- |
| arrived | Front desk checks in, workup starts | who is on deck, wait reason |
| in-exam | Refraction & exam hub — history to plan | dilation, special tests, review wait |
| optics | Frame selection, CL trials, order placed | frame / lens pick, lab promise date |
| billing | Fee quoted, payment taken | split payments, pending approvals |
| done | Visit closed, fee & paid current | advice handed over, recall booked |

- House rules: mark **no-show** after 15 minutes; a parked row keeps its stage note so any handoff is silent; the funnel mirrors the appointment book — the book's Status column is the single truth.

## Chairside quick tables

### ADD-by-age guide (40 cm working distance)

| Age | Typical ADD (OU) |
| --- | --- |
| 40–44 | +0.50 to +0.75 |
| 45–49 | +0.75 to +1.00 |
| 50–54 | +1.00 to +1.50 |
| 55–59 | +1.50 to +1.75 |
| 60–64 | +1.75 to +2.00 |
| 65+ | +2.00 to +2.50 |

- Start at the low end, refine by working-distance and comfort; never add on top of an inaccurate distance Rx.

### Transposition (plus ↔ minus cylinder)

New sphere = sphere + cylinder · flip the cylinder sign · new axis = old axis ± 90.

| Plus-cylinder Rx | Minus-cylinder Rx |
| --- | --- |
| +1.00 +0.50 x 90 | +1.50 −0.50 x 180 |
| −2.00 −1.00 x 180 | −3.00 +1.00 x 90 |
| +0.75 +1.25 x 45 | +2.00 −1.25 x 135 |

### ±0.25 D tolerance checks (before dispense)

| Check | House tolerance |
| --- | --- |
| Sphere | ±0.25 D |
| Cylinder | ±0.25 D |
| Axis | ±2° for cyl ≥ 1.00 · ±5° for low cyl |
| Prism | ±0.25 Δ, base correct |
| Segment height / ADD | ±0.5 mm · verify ADD against Rx |

- House standard — tune to your lab's tolerance sheet and regional standards; a failed check goes back to the lab, not out the door.

## Order pipeline

Statuses: **selected** · **ordered** · **at lab** · **ready** · **dispensed** · **picked up** · **delayed**

- One row per order in the optics worklist; **Amount** and **Paid** feed the same money counters the billing desk and day sheet show.
- **Ready** rows are this hour's pickup calls — log the call in the **Comms log**.
- Outsourced edging, surfacing and repairs live on **Lab jobs**; a delayed lab job means a phone call to the lab, not a silent wait.
- Frame and lens stock draw down from **Inventory** — update the Stock column as deliveries land.
- An order closes only when it is **picked up** and fully paid; balances stay on the worklist until then.

The money desk — everyone waiting to bill, then the cash-up ritual that closes the day; quote from the **Tariff** so every price is the same price.


## Cash-up checklist

- [ ] Every billing-stage patient billed, or carried over with a note
- [ ] Fee & Paid filled for today's **done** rows — no blank money columns
- [ ] Each counter counted: **Cash** · **UPI** · **Card** · **Insurance**
- [ ] Discounts & refunds matched to scheme vouchers or an approval note
- [ ] Optical orders: Amount & Paid current, **Ready** orders called
- [ ] Day sheet rows entered per counter — Net ₹ verified against the draw
- [ ] Petty-cash vouchers logged in **Expenses**
- [ ] Tomorrow chased: no-shows rebooked, overdue recalls queued for the call-in
- [ ] Day close signed (Verified by) and the takings banked

- House rules: modes mirror the day sheet — **Cash** · **UPI** · **Card** · **Insurance**; a row closes only when **paid**; anything that cannot be reconciled tonight gets a note, never a silent carry.

# Chairside quick reference

The page to keep open on the exam-room screen — conversions, triage patterns and starter routines. Static reference content the clinic edits to match its own practice.

## Visual acuity conversion (6 m ↔ 20 ft)

| Snellen (6 m) | Snellen (20 ft) | Decimal | LogMAR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6/6 | 20/20 | 1.0 | 0.0 |
| 6/7.5 | 20/25 | 0.8 | 0.1 |
| 6/9 | 20/30 | 0.67 | 0.18 |
| 6/12 | 20/40 | 0.5 | 0.3 |
| 6/18 | 20/60 | 0.33 | 0.48 |
| 6/24 | 20/80 | 0.25 | 0.6 |
| 6/36 | 20/120 | 0.17 | 0.78 |
| 6/60 | 20/200 | 0.1 | 1.0 |
| 3/60 | 20/400 | 0.05 | 1.3 |

Below 3/60: counting fingers ≈ 2/60, hand movements ≈ 1/60, then PL / NPL.

- **Severe vision impairment (ICD-11)** — VA worse than 6/60 in the better eye; **blindness** — worse than 3/60.
- **Legal blindness (US)** — best-corrected 20/200 or worse in the better eye.
- **Driving** — most jurisdictions require 6/12 in the better eye; check local rules.

## Red eye — triage patterns

| Pattern | Think first | Do now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Watery, itchy, bilateral, seasonal | Allergic conjunctivitis | Cold compress, antihistamine drops, avoid rubbing |
| Sticky mucopurulent, injected, VA normal | Bacterial conjunctivitis | Lid hygiene + antibiotic drops; no patching |
| Watering, follicles, tender preauricular node, one eye | Adenoviral keratoconjunctivitis | Hygiene & instrument disinfection; review; no steroid without slit-lamp review |
| Ciliary flush + photophobia + deep ache + reduced VA | Anterior uveitis | Dilated slit-lamp exam; same-day referral if complicated or virgin eye |
| Hazy cornea + halos + mid-dilated fixed pupil + hard globe | **Acute angle-closure attack** | Emergency — pressure-lowering per protocol, refer now |
| FB sensation + staining defect, VA normal | Corneal abrasion / FB | Fluorescein stain, remove FB, antibiotic ointment, review 24–48 h |
| Red painful eye + reduced VA in a contact-lens wearer + infiltrate | **Microbial keratitis** | Stop lens wear, refer now; fortified antibiotics only if referral will be delayed |
| Painless bright-red wedge, clear cornea, VA normal | Subconjunctival hemorrhage | Reassure, check BP, review if recurrent |

## Drop protocols — starter routines

Copy into **Prescriptions** and tune to your practice.

| Protocol | Starter routine |
| --- | --- |
| OHT / glaucoma suspect | Timolol 0.5% 1 drop OD + latanoprost 1 drop HS; screen asthma & bradycardia before beta-blockers; target IOP per staging |
| Dry eye | Carboxymethylcellulose 0.5% QID, lid hygiene BID, omega-3 OD, 20-20-20 screen rule; punctal review if the 6-week trial fails |
| Post-cataract routine | Moxifloxacin 0.5% QID × 2 weeks; prednisolone 1% 2-hourly × 1 week then taper over 3 weeks; IOP check at week 1 |
| Allergic conjunctivitis | Olopatadine 0.1% BID, cold compress, avoid eye rubbing |
| Dilation | Tropicamide 1%, repeat once after 5 min; warn 4–6 h blur, no driving, sunglasses |
| Stye / hordeolum | Hot compresses 10 min TID; topical antibiotic if bacterial; incise if pointing; refer if cellulitis spreads |

## Refer now — red flags

- **Sudden painless vision loss** — detachment, vascular occlusion, optic neuropathy: same-hour referral.
- **Red eye with reduced vision, severe pain or photophobia** — keratitis / uveitis / angle-closure territory: same-day escalation.
- **Halos, hazy cornea, mid-dilated fixed pupil, hard globe** — acute angle-closure: emergency now.
- **Chemical splash** — irrigate 15–30 min with lids held open, check pH, then refer.
- **New flashes with a floater shower** — dilated peripheral exam within 24 h.
- **Suspected penetrating injury / intraocular foreign body** — shield, nothing by mouth, no drops, no pressure.
- **Sudden double vision, ptosis, dilated pupil with headache** — third-nerve palsy: same-day emergency.
- **Hot swollen lids with fever, restricted eye movement** — orbital cellulitis: same-day referral.
- **White pupillary reflex in a child** — leukocoria: urgent pediatric ophthalmology.
- **IOP uncontrolled on maximal tolerated therapy** — glaucoma escalation referral.

# Stock & reorder

The min-level reorder board — one table for everything on the shelf. Set a **Reorder at** floor per item; **Stock Alerter** watches Stock against it, and at/below-min rows become the purchase list. Update the Stock column as deliveries land and the board clears itself.

Categories: **frames** · **blanks** · **CL** · **solutions**

| Item | Category | Supplier | Stock | Reorder at | Cost | MRP | Updated |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

```ui-stock
```

```ui-actions
items:
  - Open patient flow | open-note:Solo/Flow.md
  - Open dispensing & orders | open-note:Solo/Dispensing.md
  - Open inventory | open-note:Clinic/Inventory.md
  - Extensions settings | open-settings
```

## Reading the board

- Rows at or below **Reorder at** are the purchase list — order before the next clinic day.
- One row per item; **frames** get a row per model/colour, **CL** a row per parameter (BC/Dia/power range), **solutions** a row per product you sell.
- Cost and MRP are plain numbers; the board flags **Updated** going stale so prices don't drift.
- The Stock Alerter extension raises the alert; this table is the single source it reads.

## Category legend

- **frames** — display and drawer stock, one row per model and colour; reorder floor ≈ two pieces per active model.
- **blanks** — lens blanks and finished single-vision stock lenses, one row per index/design; floor ≈ one Rx batch.
- **CL** — trial and per-order contact lenses, one row per parameter set; floor ≈ one fitting month.
- **solutions** — CL solutions, saline, drops and counter consumables; floor ≈ two counter weeks.

# How this bench fits

One installable WorkBench bundle = a whole solo practice setup: ten Extensions, a theme, templates, snippets and the nine Solo pages. This page is the map — what landed in the workspace, what each piece does, and how to repair or re-apply it later. Setup only: patient records are never captured, created or overwritten by an install.

## What's installed

| Extension | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Recall Campaigns | Turns the recall list into dated outreach batches — call/SMS campaigns tracked to completion |
| Day Sheet | The close-the-day ritual — every counter's take reconciled and signed off |
| Stock Alerter | Watches stock levels against the reorder floor and flags at/below-min items to the reorder board |
| Quick Phrases | One-tap clinical phrases and counseling lines dropped straight into the note |
| Referral Composer | Drafts referral letters from the exam record and logs every send |
| Optomize | The EMR engine — markdown case files, changed-values follow-ups (store only what changed), pattern matching across patients |
| Essential Diagrams | Tap-to-select anterior-segment and fundus diagrams in the exam; labeled findings flow into the workup |
| Utility Panel | Right-panel calculators — spherical equivalent, toric transposition, age from DOB, IOP with pachymetry correction |
| Quick Actions | The dockable launcher for the actions the desk actually taps, in your order |
| Sidebar | Installed **switched off** — the Solo pages are the chrome. Enable it any time under Settings → Extensions if you want it |

Manage them all under **Settings → Extensions** — disable what you don't use, re-enable what you do; nothing is ever deleted.

## The nine Solo pages

Five clinical-loop pages carry the day, and four guide pages hold the reference layer — reference, stock, audit and this map. The cards below are always the live list of what's actually in the Solo folder.

| Page | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| **Today** | My day — the morning cockpit: schedule, overdue-recall call-in list, quick actions |
| **Flow** | Patient flow — the door-to-door funnel, arrived → in-exam → optics → billing → done |
| **Refraction** | Refraction & exam hub — the workup desk, history to plan, with Essential Diagrams and chairside tables |
| **Dispensing** | Dispensing & orders — the optics worklist, frame selection to pickup |
| **Money** | Billing & day close — the billing worklist and the cash-up ritual |
| **QuickRef** | Chairside quick reference — VA conversion, red-eye triage, drop protocols, refer-now red flags |
| **Stock** | Stock & reorder — the min-level board for frames, blanks, CL and solutions |
| **Review** | Weekly review — the self-audit: week totals, registers, stats |
| **Setup** | This page — the onboarding map |

```ui-note-cards
folder: Solo
limit: 9
```

## Where templates live

Templates install as real markdown files — consents, letters, certificates and printables, each catalog entry landing in its own folder (by default `Clinic/`, with a per-template folder override where the bundle sets one). The Templates page indexes every file with a [[wiki link]], and custom documents you add under `pages/` earn a row in the same index. Copy a template into a patient file rather than editing the master.

## Re-apply from the marketplace

- Open **Settings → Extensions**, switch to the **WorkBenches** tab, and find the Solo Optometrist WorkBench — or install it from its file with **Install from file**.
- Run **Install** again any time: Extensions update in place, and starter pages are created only when missing — **an existing page always wins**, so your edits survive every re-apply.
- Re-applying never touches patient records and never deletes anything; the install dialog shows each step as it lands.
